description: Change input values in the scenario scenario_id names (a what-if keeps the base unchanged). Each change picks components (component, components, or component_type and/or carrier) and an attribute, then: a value to set; op multiply|add|clip_min|clip_max with amount to rescale a time series (year/month/hour filters); or op reset to drop the override. bus, built_from and built_to also pick. op decline: value × (1−rate)^(build_year − base_year), held at stop_year; op share_of: amount × the component's own `of` value; op retire with year (attribute lifetime): gone from that investment year on. Many changes, one call. from_file {path, sheet, component_column, columns: {attribute: column}} adds one change per row, each cited to the file. Values read from a project file by hand: give source {path, sheet, row} (on the call, or per change) and each is cited to it.

replace_timeseries.description: true to replace a series with one value.

source.description: The project file the values came from.

scenario_id.description: Required: where the change goes. A what-if scenario by name or id (create_scenarios makes one), or "base" for the model itself, only when the user asked to change the model.

source.description: The project file the values came from.
